## Project Overview

**Bhedetar Spring** - Modern React/Next.js website for mineral water business with future POS integration.

- Framework: Next.js 15+ (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Ready for: E-commerce, POS system integration
- Build Status: ✅ Passing

## Key Directories

- `/app` - Next.js app pages and layouts
- `/components` - React components (Header, Hero, Products, etc.)
- `/lib` - Utilities and helpers
- `/public` - Static assets (images, icons)

## Running the Project

Development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) to view it in your browser.

Build for production:
```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

## Project Components Created

✅ **Navigation.tsx** - Fixed header with logo, links, mobile menu
✅ **Hero.tsx** - Landing section with animated background
✅ **Products.tsx** - 4-bottle showcase with pricing
✅ **Benefits.tsx** - 6 feature cards with statistics
✅ **Contact.tsx** - Contact form with info section
✅ **Footer.tsx** - Footer with links and social media

## Development Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for all components
- Follow Tailwind CSS utility-first approach
- Keep components in `/components` folder
- Use server components by default in Next.js 15+
- Prepare for POS API integration in `/lib/api`

## File Locations

- Page: `/app/page.tsx`
- Layout: `/app/layout.tsx`
- Components: `/components/*.tsx`
- Styles: `/app/globals.css`
- Config: `tailwind.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`
